sources.title: GitHub - YingyingYan1/HeatTok
sources.snippet: HeatTok: A semantic-aligned tokenizer that utilizes a thermodiffusion mechanism to adaptively aggregate fine-grained regions. By merging adjacent homogeneous areas, it generates boundary-adherent tokens, substantially reducing semantic mixture and fragmentation.

sources.title: HeatTok: Enhancing Remote Sensing Image Understanding via ...
sources.snippet: Extensive evaluations on the VRSBench and EarthVQA datasets demonstrate that HeatTok effectively preserves object-level semantic integrity and achieves state-of-the-art performance under a reasonable token budget.
